title: Python Inheritance & super()
description: Inheritance allows us to define a class that inherits all the methods and properties from another class. The 'super()' function is a built-in method that allows the child class to easily access methods of the parent class without explicitly naming the parent class.

challenges.title: Super Function
challenges.exercise: Create class 'Child' from 'Parent'. Inside Child's __init__, call super().__init__(). Print 'Init'.
